description: On-brand visual work: capture a brand once as a brand.json the Word and PowerPoint converters apply, and plan a deck slide by slide for its audience.

prerequisites: Your logo as a PNG file, and your brand colours if you know them
first-value.starter-task: Capture your brand once, then outline a deck for it
first-value.starter-prompt: Set up our brand kit from this logo (./brand/logo.png) and these colours: #0E5A46, #F2A541. Then outline a five-slide deck from ./notes/q3-update.md for Thursday's team meeting.
first-value.verification: brand-kit writes brand.json and a one-page BRAND.md with contrast checked, and slide-outliner returns a slide-by-slide outline with takeaway titles and speaker notes, sized to the time.
first-value.recovery: If brand-kit does not activate, ask for it by name ("use brand-kit"). To turn the outline into a .pptx in your brand, the converters pack's md-to-pptx takes the same brand.json with --brand.

journey.when: You need a deck or document in your own branding and do not want to answer the brand questions every time.
you_bring: your logo as a PNG, and a white version if you have one
brand colours, fonts or a PowerPoint template, if you know them
the content: the doc or points for the deck
the audience and how long you have to present

steps.you_do: Hand over your logo, colours and any brand guidelines or template.
steps.you_get: A brand.json and a one-page BRAND.md, with text contrast checked and each value traced to where it came from.

steps.you_do: Give it the content, the audience and the time slot.
steps.you_get: A slide-by-slide outline with takeaway titles, key points, speaker notes, backup slides for likely questions, and a slide-count check against the time.

steps.you_do: Run it on the outline against the deck rubric.
steps.you_get: A verdict and severity-tagged findings with a fix for each.
steps.decide: Build the deck from the outline, apply the changes, or rework it.

journey.you_end_with: A reusable brand kit and a reviewed outline, ready to become an on-brand .pptx with md-to-pptx from the converters pack.
